question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**from under**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Blank 2 in the given sentence will imply the position from which the cat came out.
 
• Among the given options, the most appropriate phrase for blank 2 is "from under."
 
 
• **The preposition "from" is used to indicate the starting point of a movement**.(ओर से)
 
 
• Example: A cold wind blew from the west side.
 
 
 
• While, **"under" describes a position or location below something**.(नीचे)
 
 
• Example: The ball was kept under the table.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, **the phrase "from under" correctly defines that the cat came from below the parked car.**

Therefore, **the correct option is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "by under", is not grammatically correct as "by" is not a suitable preposition to describe the movement in this context.
 
• Option 2, "from over", is incorrect as it describes a movement from a position above something, which is the opposite of the intended meaning.
 
• Option 4, "side under", is also incorrect as it does not accurately describe the movement of emerging from a position below something.
